subject: Hosted capacity surge — evaluating Dedicated vs Private VPC
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara@atlashealth.ai>
Cc: Mike Rogers <mike.rogers@atlashealth.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Quick recap + immediate asks after today's discovery call

Hi Sara / Mike —

Thanks for taking the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed path forward so we can move quickly given the service disruptions you mentioned this morning.

Summary from call:
- Atlas experienced a Hosted API saturation event during peak ET hours earlier this week (reported ~2 hours of degraded response for search ranking).
- Primary constraints: burst concurrency (peak 800 RPS), 95th-percentile latency requirement <250ms, and HIPAA-adjacent data handling concerns for some workflows.
- Short-term need: immediate mitigation to avoid repeated user-impacting outages.
- Mid-term need: deterministic capacity for core production (options: Redwood Dedicated or Redwood Private VPC/on-prem).

Immediate asks (what we need from you to scope both a mitigation and a migration):
1) Please attach your 7‑day peak/tail RPS report (UTC timestamps) and a sample request size distribution.
2) Confirm whether PHI appears in payloads for the ranking path (yes/no).
3) Procurement timeline and point of contact for PO terms (we will share a short SOW and T&M ceilings for the two-week mitigation).

Proposed short-term mitigations (we can execute within 48 hours if needed):
- Temporary hosted burst increase + protective routing to a lighter model for non-critical traffic.
- Rate-limit based fallbacks for heavier generations.
- A rapid Dedicated evaluation: 2-week Dedicated trial with reserved slots to prove latency/SLA before committing to Private.

Next steps I can own this week:
- Karthik to run an ops deep-dive on traffic profiles (if you share the 7-day report).
- I'll send a short SOW and onboarding checklist so Procurement can begin review while we do the technical deep-dive.
- Schedule a 30m connectivity call with your security team if PHI is in scope.

I'll attach a blank SOW and our Dedicated onboarding checklist for your review. Can you get the RPS report and procurement contact over by Monday EOD? If you prefer, we can also stand up the short-term hosted burst today — tell me yes/no and I'll escalate.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Patel <sara@atlashealth.ai>

Cc: Mike Rogers <mike.rogers@atlashealth.ai>, procurement@atlashealth.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Quick recap + immediate asks after today's discovery call

Hi Soojin —

Appreciate the clear recap. Attaching the 7‑day peak/tail export (hosted_capacity_report_Q1.pdf). Key notes from our side:
- The incident earlier this week was triggered by a third‑party job that unexpectedly re-played a backlog; peak concurrent traffic hit ~820 RPS (10s maxima) and we saw retry storms from some clients.
- PHI: ranking payloads can contain limited PHI fields (patient initials + hashed IDs). Security will want Private VPC for any persistent PHI processing.
- Procurement timeline: we can get an initial PO within 7–10 business days if terms are standard; procurement@atlashealth.ai is the POC.

Immediate ask from Atlas: can Redwood provide a short-term safety net TODAY — increase hosted burst capacity + routing to a cheaper model for non-critical requests until we land a more deterministic solution? If so, we will approve a 2‑week trial Dedicated evaluation and prioritize security conversations.

Regards,
Sara Patel
Head of Platform Engineering
Atlas Health

Attachment: hosted_capacity_report_Q1.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara@atlashealth.ai>, Mike Rogers <mike.rogers@atlashealth.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick recap + immediate asks after today's discovery call

Soojin / Sara —

Thanks for the report, Sara — looks consistent with what we suspected. A few technical clarifications and recommended immediate actions:

Clarifications needed to size Dedicated/private correctly:
- Confirm typical token length per ranking request (median and 95th).
- Proportion of reads vs writes per second (are these inference-only requests?).

Short-term recommendations (can be implemented within a day):
1) Hosted burst increase (we can route an additional 350 RPS capacity to Atlas for 48–72 hours while we validate). Needs explicit confirmation from your team to enable immediately.
2) Protective routing: tag a subset of traffic (non-login endpoints) to a quantized model variant (cost/latency friendly).
3) Apply per-customer token-cap and priority queues to avoid retry storms impacting control plane.

Dedicated vs Private guidance:
- Dedicated: fastest path to deterministic throughput and predictable cost; we can reserve slots to meet the 800+ RPS peak. Timeline: infra provisioning + model onboarding ~10–14 business days (can be accelerated with an approved PO and prioritized onboarding).
- Private VPC: recommended if PHI will be processed persistently and your security team requires VPC isolation, KMS/HSM integrations, or on-prem options. Timeline: typically 4–8 weeks depending on network approvals.

I've attached our SOC2 summary for security discussion and a short checklist of network ports/egress rules we need for a VPC setup (see soc2_summary_2025.pdf). If you confirm token sizes and PHI scope, I can produce an estimated Dedicated configuration and cost this afternoon.

Karthik
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Attachments: soc2_summary_2025.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara@atlashealth.ai>, Mike Rogers <mike.rogers@atlashealth.ai>, procurement@atlashealth.ai
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: URGENT: Atlas needs a short-term mitigant + pricing approval for Dedicated trial

Ben / Team —

Atlas confirmed PHI in some ranking payloads and an operational incident this week that makes this urgent. They asked for a hosted burst increase TODAY and are willing to run a 2‑week Dedicated trial with a view to moving to Private VPC for production. Procurement is on a 7–10 day cadence.

Immediate asks for Redwood commercial ops:
- Approve a short-term hosted burst increase (350 RPS) for 72 hours. I need signoff to enable this today.
- Approve a 2‑week Dedicated evaluation bundle (cost + reserved slot proposal). I'll attach a draft SOW and the onboarding checklist for redlines.
- Prepare a short, one‑page PO template that Procurement can sign quickly for the Dedicated trial.

If we can enable the burst and provide a PO + SOW today, Atlas will fast-track the Dedicated evaluation and start security paperwork for Private. I propose we run the trial while parallelizing the VPC security review — that keeps them operational and minimizes user impact.

Attaching: sow-draft-atlas.docx, redwood_dedicated_onboarding_checklist.xlsx. Ben, can you confirm pricing for the two-week trial and whether we can offer a provisional credit if the Dedicated nodes don't meet latency SLOs?

Thanks,
Soojin
